Hi, I'm MRTFSTONE and as a Jungle main I will admit that the new jungle can be a hassle since its recent change when the new summoners rift came out. I'm here to help with what I can.

Picking Champs:

The current META of champions in the jungle are: VI, Jarvan IV, Pantheon, Rek'Sai, Warwick, Shaco, and Lee Sin in that order. This list of champions dominates the jungle when done correctly because of a few things

(I didnt put Wukong here because I feel his early jungle clear hurts too much but that might just be my ability to play him)

  1. All of them either have either:

     a. A form of CC

 b. Sustain

 c. Great pre-6 ganking potental

  2. All of them (Minus Lee Sin and Shaco) Scale relatively well into the lategame. (Shaco though having fantastic split push potential)

3.Most of them (Minus Shaco again D:) can build tank if they fall behind or the team is without a tank

Tank jungles have seen a boost in usefulness since they can survive in the jungle so picks like Amumu, Maokai, Rammus, Nautilus and my personal favorite Shen are more of a viable pick. I say this but it will take more practice with these champions than the top few since they wont be carry junglers. Just practice hard and you might find their ability to get your team fed rather than yourself is more of a desirable trait

Jungle Clear

It is important to come up with different ways to clear the jungle depending on how your team is matched up. If your botlane seems like it isn't confident in its ability to fight the enemy botlane then plan your route accordingly by going Gromp->Blue->Wolves->Red->Krugs->Gank If a teemo on top worries your Nasus then help him get the furry satan first by going Krugs->Red->Wolves->Blue->Gromp->Gank

It is best to leave Razorbeaks(Chickens) out of your first clear as they do the most damage of all the camps early on but if you are feeling brave KILL THE SMALL CHICKENS FIRST, their combined Damage does more than the large chicken

KILL RIVER CRAB EVERY POSSIBLE CHANCE YOU GET(Hell its a free ward, EXP, and gold so why not??)

Passive Ganking

This concept is spawned from many games in the jungle Passive Ganking is the process of making an appearence in a lane without fully ganking.

Passive Ganking can be useful to just make an enemy laner back off, once or twice may not be enough though so Passive Gank two or three times to make the enemy laner think you may still be there when in fact you have actually left forcing them to think twice about attacking.

When to Gank

Use pings and the chat to set up ganks and inform the laners that there will be no ganks if they have pushed to their tower, because that makes no sense

This part is for NON-JUNGLERS, Hey you, Botlaners who fed the Kalista and Thresh three kills before 8 minutes I will not be ganking you nor should anyone else. Instead of giving them 2 people to munch on in the botlane lets give them 3, THAT MAKES A LOT OF SENSE. Get your crap together and farm under tower. 9 times out of 10 it is NOT the junglers fault but the fault of the laner(s) who fed. There are too many people who lose lane and instantly say "GG no jungle ganks, Report" when you spent 10 minutes thinking that "nah that blitz grab cant possibly hit me 4 times, IMMA GET LUCKY THIS TIME" Junglers have a tough job and when you feed and blame us it just makes the job harder, It also turns a lot of people away from the jungle position because one screw up can mean you get 9 reports that you don't deserve.

This last part is for everyone

Be Humble in Victory, Graceful in Defeat. Win or lose say GG and maybe they will honor you or friend you and you both can be stuck in EloHell together

Maybe I'll have more tips later but for now that's it for me

-MRTFSTONE
